01 — About

Electronics & Communication
Engineer.

I'm a final-year B.Tech Electronics & Communication Engineering student at Christ College of Engineering (KTU). My depth is in embedded systems — schematic capture and PCB layout in KiCad, tight C++ firmware for ESP32, Raspberry Pi Pico W, and TIVA C, and full IoT pipeline design from sensor node to cloud endpoint.

I'm fluent in SIM800L GSM, WiFi, and Bluetooth architectures, integrating peripherals over UART, I2C, and SPI. Every project goes through the full hardware lifecycle — component selection, PCB layout, 3D-printed enclosures, and deployed firmware.

Beyond the bench: trained 100+ students per session across 7+ institutions, led national tech-fests, and currently serve as Accessibility Co-chair at Young Indians and Community Co-lead at META Hub.

Selected Projects.

03 — 2024Featured on Tomson Electronics
Mechanical 7-Segment Clock (ESP32)
A fully mechanical 7-segment display clock driven by ESP32. Every digit is a servo-driven physical segment. From concept to AutoCAD to deployed C++ firmware — electromechanical timekeeping from first principles.
